name: find-sota-papers
description: Finds and verifies current research papers under explicit constraints (topic, benchmark, date, citations, well-known institutions, count, layout), with a working link and evidence links for every paper and no paper listed from memory. You choose the settings when you use it directly; polish-paper and review-paper call it in a light, automatic mode for related-work, novelty, baseline, and citation checks.

interface.shortDescription: Find and verify current research papers
interface.longDescription: Finds and verifies current research papers under explicit constraints (topic, benchmark, date, citations, well-known institutions, count, layout), with a working link and evidence links for every paper and no paper listed from memory. You choose the settings when you use it directly; polish-paper and review-paper call it in a light, automatic mode for related-work, novelty, baseline, and citation checks. It needs live web search and page fetch.
defaultPrompt: Use $find-sota-papers to find and verify the current state-of-the-art papers on my research topic.
